perks.name: Loose Change

perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: No Distractions
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period reduces flinch.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Explosive Payload
perks.desc: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Brya's Love is probably the only weapon I will really grind out, and this is only for PvE. Brya's Love has some incredible perk combinations I would love to try out. Destabilizing Rounds on void has some incredible utility. Precision Instrument will probably take the cake as the next Vorpal Weapon being able to scale up damage with ease. Pair that with Rapid Hit to really get the most for your precision hits. Another great perk to craft would be Shoot to Loot to get your ammo and orbs from a distance. Not being required to chase after orbs is a pretty big benefit." Recommended MW: Handling or Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "In PvP Brya's could see some niche usage like a Box Breathing Hung Jury. I don't think it will be enough to break the meta but it will be a unique pick on longer ranged maps. I don't find myself swapping weapons depending on the map, but it would be a safe pick on Widow's Court or Eternity." Recommended MW: Stability.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 76 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4UoXFYD3DbunDEKIGDiriX?si=1957400d9e024ed5) with @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE pick for Minor Spec enemies in end-game content. Shapeable. Brya's Love - named after Eris's Ghost - is up against Doom of Chelchis as a void precision frame scout rifle so, as you'd expect, doesn't fare well in a straight stat comparison. There are still some useful and unique trait combinations available to craft. For the barrel perk, Fluted Barrel or Smallbore are probably your top two choices - as a precision frame, the recoil direction stat doesn't really matter - or you could opt to go all into Stability with Polygonal Rifling or range with Hammer-Forged Rifling. For the magazine perk, Tactical Mag is the best choice, or possibly Appended mag of one more shot. As your support trait, Shoot to Loot is really useful in end-game activities - both safely collecting ammo bricks and reloading all your weapons at the same time. This pairs well with Explosive Payload as the signature trait which both adds free damage against enemies, and extends the ammo pickup range of Shoot to Loot. Whether you find the Head Rush origin trait useful will depend on how often you crouch and get up again - if you do, the additional handling and reload speed is useful, if not game-changing. Recommended MW: Stability, with a damage-boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) or Backup Mag mod.
